summary: Completed frontend testing of BUG-108 Coupon V1B Implementation in POS Collect Payment panel. All core coupon UI elements and behaviors are working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: KUNAFA20 is an item-scope (V2) coupon, so /validate returns error 'Coupon could not be applied'. This is EXPECTED behavior per the test requirements - V1 only supports order-scope coupons.

critical_code_review_comments: All required data-testid attributes are correctly implemented in CollectPaymentPanel.jsx
Coupon section visibility is correctly gated by customer selection and restaurantSettings.isCoupon
Error handling for all CRM error codes is properly implemented (errorCodeToCopy function)
Loyalty + coupon stacking conflict is correctly handled with auto-remove and toast notification
seed_data_creation: None - used existing order #009499 for abhishek jain
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coupon V1B implementation is complete and working. KUNAFA20 is the only coupon for restaurant 689 and it's an item-scope (V2) coupon, so full apply flow won't work - but all UI elements, API calls, error handling, and dropdown behavior are working correctly.

coupon_section_visibility.details: Coupon section appears in Collect Payment panel when customer is selected (data-testid='coupon-section')

coupon_dropdown_typeahead.details: Coupon input (data-testid='coupon-input') is present. Dropdown appears on focus (data-testid='coupon-suggestions-dropdown'). KUNAFA20 coupon shown with -₹0 (expected for item-scope coupon).

available_api_call.details: /available API call is made on coupon input focus. Coupon list loads correctly.

validate_api_call.details: /validate API call is made when Apply button clicked or dropdown item selected.

error_messages.details: Error messages displayed correctly: 'Cannot combine coupon with loyalty points' (STACKING_NOT_ALLOWED), 'Invalid coupon code' (INVALID_CODE), 'Coupon could not be applied' (item-scope coupon)

dropdown_click_behavior.details: Clicking on coupon suggestion row triggers /validate directly (B-3 behavior)

loyalty_stacking_conflict.details: When loyalty is enabled and coupon with stackableWithLoyalty=false is applied, error is shown. Loyalty can be disabled to attempt coupon apply.

apply_button.details: Apply button (data-testid='apply-coupon-btn') is present and functional

data_testid_attributes.details: All required data-testid attributes are present: coupon-section, coupon-input, apply-coupon-btn, coupon-suggestions-dropdown, coupon-suggestion-KUNAFA20, coupon-error-text, coupon-pos-instruction-text, coupon-empty-hint, coupon-outside-window-hint

notes: KUNAFA20 is an item-scope (V2) coupon with discount_scope=item and requires_cart_validation=true. V1 only supports order-scope coupons, so /validate returns an error. This is expected behavior.
The coupon dropdown shows KUNAFA20 with -₹0 expected discount because it's an item-scope coupon where expected_discount from /available is null.
All CRM API calls go to live staging CRM at https://mongodb-crm-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/api - NO MOCKED APIs
